title: Word Break
description: Given a string s and a dictionary of words, return whether s can be segmented into a sequence of one or more dictionary words (words may be reused).

reference.use_case: Splitting text with no spaces into valid dictionary words, such as segmenting hashtags, domain names, or text in languages written without spaces.
system_examples: CJK and Thai tokenizers in search engines (e.g. Elasticsearch ICU and Kuromoji analyzers) — dictionary-based word segmentation
Hashtag and domain-name segmentation for search and analytics (#throwbackthursday → throwback thursday)
Spell checkers — detecting missing spaces between words
reference.explanation: dp[i] is true if some dictionary word ends at position i and dp at that word's start is true, giving O(n²) substring checks (or O(n·L) when bounded by the longest word). Production segmenters extend this with word probabilities to pick the most likely split.
